profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary: Frontend engineer with over 7 years of experience working in digital commerce spaces at Microsoft and Liberty Mutual with a focus on the intersection of design, strategy, and engineering. I have a strong passion for web technologies and helping underrepresented communities gain opportunities in tech.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing and supporting Graphite – a Mastercard Design System.

- Led technical implementation of dark mode across our React design system; Architected the token pipeline with Style Dictionary and authored the implementation guide that helped teams roll it out.
- Owned end-to-end implementation of the Takeover Modal component, from API design to accessibility features like focus-trapping and scroll lock, now adopted by multiple product teams.
- Performed accessibility research and remediation guidance for several core components that enabled junior engineers to independently ship a11y fixes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Commerce Platform
positions.description:
• Drove 150,000 successful checkouts per week across 7 different commercial checkout flows by designing new features within a React component library and C# Commerce API service.
• Led cross-functional collaboration, dev design reviews, and end-to-end testing for the development of a new UI panel in our component library that allowed admin-level users to purchase and provision product licenses across multiple tenants during checkout.
• Enhanced payment selector and bill-to address form components to enable EU-based customers in Microsoft Admin Center to use payment methods from other EU countries, ensuring compliance support.
• Implemented automated test suites in TestIM, using both mock data and real test accounts, to verify expected step-by-step behavior for all of our supported frontend checkout flows.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Digital Sales
positions.description:
• Developed a toggle editing feature for binary coverages (Included vs Not Included) to test against the current edit modal experience in our three-price presentation application using branded design system components.
• Collaborated with product, design, and engineering in quarterly design sprints to iterate on potential new features that improved customer experience and observed user interviews with mock designs.
• Increased customer conversion KPIs by $4.5 million by implementing an A/B test of a compacted price layout within our renters quoting flow.
• Led the refactor of our legacy (Dojo) and newer (React) applications to make them compliant with the WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) standards by the March 2020 deadline.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Supporting and developing various Global Finance Technology applications used internally by Treasury, Reinsurance, and the Corporate Aircraft departments from the start of the design process all the way through to production and devOps support.

positions.title: Technology Associate, TechStart IT Development Program
positions.description: Participated in a design thinking intensive to strategize a solution for legal data analysts that alleviates the knowledge gap. Collaborated with early career teammates to deliver a production ready MVP Angular web application in 10 weeks.

positions.title: Release Management Intern
positions.description: Collaborated with Release Managers and Build Masters to ensure successful quarterly, and the newer bi-monthly releases and integration of new code to their respected domains by tracking the status of CRs (Change Requests).

positions.title: Business Systems Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Developed Business Requirements Documents for outdated business applications by analyzing customer wants with customer needs and producing a viable options for future business solutions.
• Gathered compliance, security background, user class, and use case information for legacy applications used by LEO-US in preparation for upcoming application upgrades.
• Organized and lead application demo meetings with application owners and business process owners to observe their functionality.

positions.title: Information Systems Intern at EmblemHealth
positions.description:
• Analyzed trends in well-regarded, competitor user interfaces in comparison to EmblemHealth’s current mobile member offering. 
• Created and presented a series of critiques as well as appraisals for their current iOS app that discussed desirable improvements and possible features to include in future updates.
• Designed a web application that connected and searched through an Excel database with over 8,000 entries on personal data of insurees using Visual Studio and SQL commands; Search results were displayed on the web page.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Science, Concentration in Information Systems

volunteerExperiences.role: Events and Volunteer Lead - Boston Chapter
volunteerExperiences.description:
- Assist with event logistics for our monthly workshops, such as the Sphero Robotics Seminar, Game Jam, Microsoft MakeCode Arcade. 
- Facilitate and lead volunteer training sessions before each workshop.
- Communicate with past volunteers about all future programs and volunteer opportunities.

organizations.name: The Partnership Inc
organizations.description: •	Nominated to represent Liberty Mutual for a year long program to develop my leadership and professional awareness in order to improve my effectiveness in an organizational culture by attending monthly workshops with other Boston-area professionals.
